description: This file provides helper functions for testing Git bitmap functionality within a shell scripting environment. It includes setup functions, test cases, and utility functions for verifying bitmap-related operations in Git repositories.

methods.name: test_bitmap_traversal
methods.description: Normalizes and compares traversal outputs to verify consistency between bitmap and non-bitmap Git rev-list outputs.

methods.name: setup_bitmap_history
methods.description: Sets up a Git repository with a complex commit history and merges to test bitmap traversal algorithms.

methods.name: rev_list_tests_head
methods.description: Runs various rev-list tests on specified branches using bitmap and non-bitmap options.

methods.name: rev_list_tests
methods.description: Runs rev-list tests on 'second' and 'other' branches.

methods.name: basic_bitmap_tests
methods.description: Performs a series of tests to verify bitmap functionality, including enumeration, counting, cloning, partial fetches, and delta verification.

methods.name: have_delta
methods.description: Checks if a specific object is stored as a delta base to an expected base object.

methods.name: midx_pack_source
methods.description: Finds the pack source of an object in the multi-pack index.

methods.name: test_rev_exists
methods.description: Verifies the existence of a reverse index for a given commit, checking for expected category and source info in trace logs.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_core
methods.description: Main function to create, verify, and manipulate multi-pack indexes with bitmap support. Includes extensive tests for bitmap creation, revision verification, pack handling, delta management, and clone operations.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_partial_tests
methods.description: Performs partial bitmap testing, including setup of packed and loose objects, and analyzes the behavior of partial bitmaps.
